details:
"User is in a private world" has become a meme among the community and showing how dated and misinformed the players can be
Using descriptive statements, a Player can be informed of a friend being in world without using the dated term "Private World"

Such statements such as:
"User is Online in someone's friends-only world" 
"User Is in Someone's Invite Only World" 
"User Is in Someone's Invite+ Only World"
title: Better Description for friend locations
